description: This file declares types, function prototypes, and includes for the collection mechanism within the lighttpd server, enabling execution of functions across worker contexts and handling their callbacks.

methods.name: li_collect_start
methods.description: Starts collecting data by executing a function in a specific worker context, returning a liCollectInfo pointer.

methods.name: li_collect_start_global
methods.description: Starts collecting data globally across the server, using the main worker and never returning until completion.

methods.name: li_collect_break
methods.description: Aborts or breaks an ongoing collection operation.

ctags.name: liCollectCB
ctags.pattern: /^typedef void (*liCollectCB)(liWorker *wrk, gpointer cbdata, gpointer fdata, GPtrArray *result, g/
ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(liWorker * wrk,gpointer cbdata,gpointer fdata,GPtrArray * result,gboolean complete)
